source.notes: ICSE Grade VIII school assessment paper (school not named). Header prints 'Grade - VIII', 'ASSESSMENT - II', 'Computer', 'Time- 2 hours', 'M.M:- 100'. No year is printed on the paper; examYear 2024 is taken from the file name (...-290224-2024) and the icseboard.org folder. The PDF has no text layer (watermark only); text was OCRed with RapidOCR and corrected against the page images. Marks are printed only per group, so each group is one entry with its printed total. 'X. Practical [20]' is printed with no question text, so it is not included; the listed questions total 80 of 100. A WhatsApp/Paytm advertisement box on page 3 is page furniture and ignored. Graphics-tool items (Free Transform, stroke, Lasso, Brush) have no listed chapter and sit inside mixed groups. No answer key is printed; no official answers exist.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.

questions.text:
Choose the correct answer:-
1. How many options are there in Free Transform Tool? (a) One (b) Two (c) Three (d) Four
2. ____topology does not use switches or repeaters. (a) Bus (b) Car (c) Ring (d) Chain
3. The process of software development is called the ____. (a) CDLC (b) SDCL (c) SDLC (d) SCDL
4. Which is the outline colour of an object? (a) Stroke color (b) Stroke Height (c) Stroke Style (d) Fill color
5. In ____topology, each workstation is connected to a central switch. (a) Tree (b) Star (c) Ring (d) Bus
6. The ____statement can be used to check whether a given year is leap year or not. (a) if (b) whether (c) Goto (d) if else
7. Many computers are connected to one computer which work as a ____. (a) HUB (b) Server (c) PDA (d) None of the above
8. Choose the odd one (a) BUS (b) Tree (c) Star (d) CAN
9. ____is a data type in java. (a) long (b) tall (c) Not (d) variable
10. Choose the odd one (a) Assignment (b) Relational (c) Keyword (d) Logical
